reviews.title: Great monitor
reviews.comment: I didn't realize what I was missing in color and detail until I brought this monitor! I was using a Asus monitor that was 10 years old that still had the VGA connector! This one has a DVI so I have DVI on video card and monitor! The picture is sharp and bright beautiful colors! I was amazed, I recommend whole heartily! My games look so much better!
reviews.author: Michael J. Kohler

reviews.title: Great Monitor – Just Wish It Was Height Adjustable
reviews.comment: Overall, this is a great gaming monitor — crisp display, smooth performance, and no complaints when it comes to visuals or responsiveness. The quality is solid, and it works perfectly for gaming and everyday use. The only thing that would make it even better is the ability to adjust the height. Many other brands offer that feature, and it would really add to the comfort and flexibility. Hopefully, ASUS considers adding that in future models. Still, a great purchase!
reviews.author: Yk

reviews.title: Mi experiencia comprando el monitor
reviews.comment: Tenia dudas de si comprarlo o no pero a la final me lo termine comprando y a la semana luego de que se haga el pago me llegó y lo mejor en muy buen estado, si están pensando en comprarselo se los recomiendo  sin duda, me ha ido todo bien sin problemas. Excelente monitor
